content.text:
good morning — hope the coffee's still warm.

one thing on the radar this week: Juno's 4-year checkup is coming up in about three weeks. it's a good one to get on the books if it isn't already — your pediatric office can confirm what's typically on the agenda at that visit (vision screening, a few vaccines, and a general developmental check are common at this age, but they'll walk you through it). Wren is on the family list too, just so you know they're accounted for.

nothing new locally this week — the village feed is quiet, so no fresh classes or activities to sort through. a calm sunday to you. ☕
